name: codex-qa-memory
description: Local-first Codex QA diary and evidence toolkit for Obsidian-backed knowledge workflows.

scripts.test: npm run test:python && npm run test:powershell
scripts.test:python: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$env:PYTHONPATH='qa-logger/src'; python -m unittest discover -s qa-logger/tests"
scripts.test:powershell: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File skills/codex-qa-diary-recall/tests/install_core_isolated.ps1 && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File skills/codex-qa-diary-recall/tests/install_task_preflight.ps1 && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File skills/codex-qa-diary-recall/tests/qa_health_isolated_probe.ps1
